# The AI Strategist

> "The AI Strategist" defines a professional role at the intersection of AI,
> business strategy, and execution — a role that exists in 400+ job postings
> worldwide but has never been formally defined by any government agency,
> consulting firm, academic institution, or standards body. This open-source
> book by Satoshi Yamauchi (山内怜史), AI Strategist, structurally proves the
> gap left by existing professions and defines what this role requires and
> how it functions.

## Book Content

- [Full text (Japanese)](docs/jp/the-ai-strategist_jp.md): 本文・日本語版
- [Full text (English)](docs/en/the-ai-strategist_en.md): Complete English edition

## Key Facts (specific to this book)

- Three principles: Vendor Independence, Outcome Commitment, Embedded
  Engagement (modeled structurally on Palantir's Forward Deployed Engineer)
- Four-layer competency model: AI Literacy at Depth, Business Architecture,
  Execution through Methodology, and the foundational layer of
  Boundary-Spanning Capability (BTC crossover)

## Author & Full Catalog

This book is one of 20+ open-source books by Satoshi Yamauchi (山内怜史),
AI Strategist & Business Designer at Sun Asterisk Inc., Founder of Leading.AI.

> **AI Strategist author profile & all definitions (10:80:10 Rule, Depth &
> Velocity, BTC Crossover) are maintained centrally at the organization hub:**
> **https://github.com/Leading-AI-IO**
